name: Four Way Junction
source:
When a recent college grad finds himself anxious about where life's about to take him— he suddenly finds himself the winner of a dubious, fully-paid vacation to a mysterious island! 

...and he isn't the only one whisked away on an unforeseen opportunity for adventure.

[From [url=https://genericvnstudio.itch.io/four-way-junction]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一位刚大学毕业的年轻人开始焦虑人生将把自己带向何处，却突然发现自己赢得了一趟可疑的全额付费假期，目的地是一座神秘岛屿！

……而被意外机遇带去冒险的，可不止他一个。

[来源：[url=https://genericvnstudio.itch.io/four-way-junction]Itch.io[/url]]
